Unit: Required if the price type is Unit. Leave this field empty if the price Type is either Fixed or Variable.
Min Price: Optional (This field can only be modified when pricing type is variable); The value should be Tax-Inclusive as per your Display Price setting in the BackOffice.
Max Price: Optional (This field can only be modified when pricing type is variable); The value should be Tax-Inclusive as per your Display Price setting in the BackOffice.
Supplier Price: Optional(this field can only be modified if Fix Supplier Price is selected for at least one store in Account Settings)
Product Tags: Optional; use semicolon ( ; ) to separate multiple tags
Inventory Type: Optional(Simple/Composite/Serialized; Simple by default if tracking inventory)
Track Stock Levels: Required; Enter 0 to disable; 1 to enable
Barcode: Optional; Must be unique if specified; use semicolon ( ; ) to separate multiple barcodes
Supplier: Optional; use semicolon ( ; ) to separate multiple suppliers
Kitchen Station: Optional; Leave it blank for Default Kitchen Station; Enter 'Do Not Print Kitchen Docket' to not print kitchen docket
ORLOFF OF DENMARK (BLUPORT)_Quantity: Optional; 0 by default if tracking inventory. Denominated in this row's Base Unit (the product's only unit when blank) — e.g. Base Unit g + quantity 5 for 5 g
ORLOFF OF DENMARK (BLUPORT)_Warning Stoc: Optional; Numeric only. Denominated in this row's Base Unit. Leave blank if you do not want to receive low-stock notification
ORLOFF OF DENMARK (BLUPORT)_Ideal Stock: Optional; Numeric only. Denominated in this row's Base Unit. Leave blank if you do not want to auto suggest restock
Online Price: Optional; The value should be Tax-Inclusive as per your Display Price setting in the BackOffice.
Online Discounted Price: Optional; The value should be Tax-Inclusive as per your Display Price setting in the BackOffice.
